title: What happened on this account, and in what order -
summary: A consumer's calls, emails, texts, portal sign-ins and payments usually sit in four systems. Account Explorer puts them on one page, in the order they happened, so a person or an AI agent can read the account before deciding what to do next.
body_markdown:
By Karan Ashta


Here is one consumer’s month while their account is past due.


- **Oct 2:** an AI agent called and reached voicemail.
- **Oct 9:** the consumer called back with a question about the balance.
- **Oct 26:** the AI agent reached them again, and they promised to pay.
- **Oct 28:** they set up a payment plan, signed in to the payment portal and made a payment.
- **That evening:** the receipt went out by email and text.
- **Later that night:** they signed in again through a magic link.


To the consumer, that was one conversation with one company. In most systems it sits in four places: the dialer, the email platform, the portal and the payment system. Account Explorer puts it on one page, in the order it happened, so a person or an AI agent can read the account before deciding what to do next.


## Read the account, then decide


Read in order, an account also shows how a consumer responds. A week after a voicemail, the consumer above called in with a question, and when the AI agent reached them again they promised to pay. Two days later they set up a plan, paid, opened the receipt and came back to the portal through a magic link that night.


That reads as someone who answers a direct conversation and is comfortable paying online. The next touch should build on what worked last time.


## Shape outreach around what consumers actually do


Across a portfolio, the same view shows which messages move people. Every email on the timeline carries its delivery, open and click status, with the sign-ins and payments that followed right below it. Teams can see which reminders bring consumers back to the portal and where they stop between signing in and paying.


That turns campaign planning into specific choices about who to contact next, on which channel and with which message. proCollect makes those choices from the same record.


## Start every conversation knowing the account


Whether the next contact comes from a collector or an AI agent, it goes better with the history in view. Before a call, a collector can see every past attempt and how it ended, the promise made last week and the plan set up since. The call picks up where the account left off, and the consumer doesn’t have to explain it again.


proAgent works from the same picture, so an AI call starts with the context a person would have.


## Answer any question about an account in minutes


When a client, an auditor or the consumer asks what happened, the answer is one search away. Any email opens exactly as the consumer received it, with the values filled into its template, and can be saved as a PDF.


## Every app writes to the same record


Account Explorer can show the whole sequence because one platform ran every touch on the account, and each part of it adds to the same record.


- **proAgent** handles conversations: AI calls and chat, with every attempt and its outcome.
- **proCollect** runs the digital strategy: who to contact, when, on which channel and with what message.
- **proPay** handles payments: portal sign-ins, magic links, plans and payments.


Under all three sits PIE, our consolidated intelligence layer. PIE reads every account and every interaction, so each app works from one picture of the consumer. The record your team reads in Account Explorer is the same one our agents and outreach act on.


## See it on your own accounts


Account Explorer is live. Search any account by name, account ID, client, email or phone, and its full history opens on one page. Ask your Prodigal team member for a walkthrough on one of your own accounts.
